question: What is the average projected monthly sales in USD for France in 2021, considering only product sales with promotions where promo_total_id = 1 and channels where channel_total_id = 1, by taking each product’s monthly sales from 2019 and 2020, calculating the growth rate from 2019 to 2020 for that same product and month, applying this growth rate to project 2021 monthly sales, converting all projected 2021 amounts to USD with the 2021 exchange rates, and finally averaging and listing them by month?
sql:
WITH historical_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON c.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN times t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
      AND c.country_total_id = 52806
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
sales_with_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        monthly_sales,
        calendar_year,
        CASE WHEN LAG(monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY prod_id, calendar_month_number ORDER BY calendar_year) IS NOT NULL
             THEN (monthly_sales - LAG(monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY prod_id, calendar_month_number ORDER BY calendar_year)) 
                  / LAG(monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY prod_id, calendar_month_number ORDER BY calendar_year)
             ELSE 0 
        END as growth_rate
    FROM historical_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        monthly_sales AS sales_2020,
        growth_rate,
        (growth_rate * monthly_sales) + monthly_sales AS projected_2021
    FROM sales_with_growth
),
final_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        p.prod_id,
        p.calendar_month_number,
        p.projected_2021,
        c.to_us,
        p.projected_2021 * c.to_us AS projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' AND c.year = 2021 AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT 
    calendar_month_number,
    ROUND(AVG(projected_2021_usd), 2) AS avg_projected_monthly_sales_usd
FROM final_calc
GROUP BY calendar_month_number
ORDER BY calendar_month_number
